---
title: "TAOOH — primary preparation"
subtitle: "Five-state weekly history with first- and second-order lags"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

The weekly state is 1 = alive/out of hospital, 2 = planned admission,
3 = emergency room, 4 = unplanned admission, and 5 = dead. From the first
week classified as dead onward, state 5 must remain absorbing.

```{r}
#| label: prepare-taooh-data
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
source(here::here("R", "data-helpers.R"))


force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
cohort_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"
)
taooh_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-taooh.parquet"
)
output_path <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "primary", "taooh", "prepared.parquet"
)
dir.create(dirname(output_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (force || !file.exists(output_path)) {
  cohort <- arrow::read_parquet(cohort_path) |>
    as.data.frame()
  taooh <- arrow::read_parquet(taooh_path) |>
    as.data.frame()

  if (any(!is.na(taooh$y_taooh) & !taooh$y_taooh %in% 1:5)) {
    stop("Observed TAOOH states must be in 1:5.")
  }
  
  analysis_data <- cohort |> 
    select(
      id, 
      tx, 
      age, 
      gender, 
      diagnosis,
      ecog_fstcnt, 
      stage_binary, 
      lung, 
      plan_fstcnt_coded, 
      albumin, 
      bilirubin, 
      c_reactive_protein, 
      creatinine, 
      lactate_dehydrogenase, 
      leukocytes) |> 
    left_join(taooh, by = "id") |> 
    group_by(id) |>
    arrange(id, week) |> 
    mutate(
      y = as.numeric(as.character(y_taooh)),
      yprev = lag(y_taooh, 1L),
      ypprev = lag(y_taooh, 2L)
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter_out(week < 1) |>
    filter_out(yprev == 5) |>
    filter_out(ypprev == 5) |>
    mutate(
      yprev = factor(yprev, levels = 1:4, ordered = FALSE),
      ypprev = factor(ypprev, levels = 1:4, ordered = FALSE),
      id = factor(id)
    )

  arrow::write_parquet(analysis_data, output_path)
}
```
